title: Stability of N8 isomers and isomerization reaction of N8 (C2v) to N8 (Cs)

species.method: B3LYP/6-31G* (also HF/6-31G*, B3PW91/6-31G* reported; B3LYP values transcribed here)
species.source_note: Table 2, p.138; connectivity confirmed visually from Fig. 1, p.136 (image read directly)

bond_params.connectivity_from_figure: Branched tree: central atom N1 bonded to N4 (terminal), N3, and N2; N3-N7, N7-N8 (terminal) form one arm; N2-N5, N5-N6 (terminal) form the other arm. 7 bonds total for 8 atoms (acyclic).
bond_params.caveat: Table 2 gives only 5 of the ~7 symmetry-relevant bond values (r13, r25, r56 not separately tabulated) -- paper appears to rely on C2v symmetry equivalence between the two arms (N1-N3-N7-N8 and N1-N2-N5-N6) without spelling out which values are shared. r54 (2.708 A) is an explicitly NON-bonded monitored distance (becomes the new bond in the isomerization TS to structure 7), not an actual bond in structure 6.

species.notes: Genuine local minimum (0 imaginary frequencies at all 3 levels, per Table 1). Two new N8 isomers reported in this paper are structures 6 and 7; structures 1-5 (Oh, D2h, D2d, Cs-azidopentazole, C2h) are literature references to Glukhovtsev/Jiao/Schleyer 1996 (already in existing corpus as poly-N.pdf/molecules.py), not re-tabulated with new data here, so not extracted from this paper.

bond_params.connectivity_from_figure: Same overall skeleton as 6/7 but with a four-membered ring formed by the breaking/forming N1-N2/N4-N5 bonds (see Fig.1 caption 'continued', structure 8, Cs) -- transitional four-membered-ring topology.

species.suggested_build: UNKNOWN -- transition-state structure, not a simple minimum topology; needs bespoke handling if pursued at all
species.notes: IMPORTANT: this is an explicit TRANSITION STATE (one imaginary frequency at all 3 levels: 222.2i/237.5i/280.3i cm-1, per Table 3), NOT a local minimum. Connects structure 6 (C2v) to structure 7 (Cs) via N1-N2 bond breaking and N4-N5 bond forming. Should probably be EXCLUDED from the minima/metastable-isomer comparison pool, or clearly labeled as a saddle point if kept for reference.
